# L3 verbatim-heavy code review; exact strings dominate -> plain passthrough
^plain<<<
Verbatim-heavy review stays in prose/fenced passthrough because exact quoting and line order are the substance.

```sh
psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 <<'SQL'
ALTER TABLE accounts ADD COLUMN status text;
UPDATE accounts SET status = 'active' WHERE status IS NULL;
ALTER TABLE accounts ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL;
SQL
```

Finding: acceptable only if the three SQL statements stay in that order and the heredoc remains single-quoted as <<'SQL'. Dense framing would add overhead and risk obscuring the exact strings.
>>>^plain
